name: claude-visuals
description: Unofficial mods that change how the Claude desktop app looks: dark themes, moving backgrounds and progress bars. Made for fun by Cattywampus Studio, not affiliated with Anthropic.

plugins.name: studio-looks
plugins.description: Pick the Claude desktop app's look from a collection of dark themes: colours, a moving background (a lava lamp, a synthwave grid, a night city, northern lights, a flock of pixels and more) and a matching progress bar above the message box. Unofficial: made for fun by Cattywampus Studio, not affiliated with Anthropic.
